title: Working at Tessl: Amy's Story
description:
What is it like to decode the mysteries of AI? Amy Heineike, a research engineer at Tessl, peers into the complexities of large language models, striving to understand their capabilities. It sounds daunting, yet for Amy, it's an opportunity to explore one of the most dynamic fields today. The fast-paced environment requires balancing rapid response with long-term vision. Her work involves grappling with non-existent playbooks on ambiguous problems, making it both challenging and exhilarating. 

Amy brings her expertise to Tessl as a research engineer, where she unravels the enigmatic behavior of large language models. With an affinity for tackling hard questions and a thirst for discovery, Amy utilizes the wealth of resources available at Tessl to push the boundaries of AI exploration. She believes coding is a thrilling domain for AI research, contributing to her choice of Tessl, a startup defined by its ambition and positioning in the AI-native space.

In this video:
• Why Amy thinks coding is one of the most exciting places to study AI
• How does one balance 'move fast' with 'think long-term'?
• The ingredients every researcher needs to do their best work
• Why being at a well-positioned startup right now feels like a rare opportunity
